record.question: What does a high specific speed for a turbine imply?
options: The turbine will have a larger size for the same power output compared to an impulse turbine.
The turbine is better suited for high-head, low-flow applications.
The turbine is likely an impulse turbine.
The turbine will be smaller in size and will generate more power for the same head
